style_guide.art_style: stylized 2D top-down mobile game art, clean bold silhouettes, chibi-proportioned characters (large head-to-body ratio), bright warm color palette, soft cel-shading, no gritty/realistic textures, readable at small mobile screen size, inspired by Brawl Stars' top-down clarity but with a hopeful/warm biblical-era tone instead of cartoon violence
style_guide.negative_prompt: no weapons drawn as combat tools, no blood, no violence, no photorealism, no dark/gritty tone, no text or watermarks, no extra limbs, no cropped characters
style_guide.consistency_anchor: same lighting direction (top-left soft sun), same color saturation level, same outline thickness across all assets to keep visual unity

resolution_character: 1024x1024, transparent background, centered character, top-down 3/4 angle

prompts.idle: stylized 2D top-down mobile game character, adult man Nehemiah, determined builder, simple brown tunic with tool belt, sturdy build, standing idle pose, top-down 3/4 angle, bright warm color palette, soft cel-shading, transparent background, no weapons in combat pose, no text
prompts.run_cycle_4_frames: stylized 2D top-down mobile game character sprite sheet, 4-frame running animation, adult man Nehemiah, determined builder, simple brown tunic with tool belt, sturdy build, dynamic running pose sequence, top-down 3/4 angle, bright warm color palette, soft cel-shading, transparent background, consistent character design across frames, no text
